mappings.exposureDefinition: An institution-level procedure is realized in practice and actually encountered by a person in the explicitly covered target set before the person's evaluation is measured.
mappings.membershipSemantics: Institutional membership alone does not establish exposure.
mappings.eligibilitySemantics: Formal eligibility or coverage alone does not establish receipt or encounter.
mappings.implementationSemantics: The specified procedure must be realized in practice for the applicable target set.
mappings.assignmentSemantics: Assignment alone does not establish that the person encountered the procedure.
mappings.actualExposureSemantics: The target person must actually encounter the implemented procedure.
mappings.perceivedExposureSemantics: The bounded person-level perception or evaluation is explicit and cannot be inferred from objective implementation alone.
mappings.coverageSemantics: Only persons in an explicitly defined covered set who actually encounter the implemented procedure satisfy the route.

networkStateRequirements.description: This route has no Network State dependency.

intermediateReferenceRules: Reference only an existing Driver or HappeningType that is a scientifically substantive pathway component; no plumbing entity is required here.
evidenceBindingRules: Evidence references remain subordinate to the Relationship and never make this mapping causal evidence.
